text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the scrimmage against the
veteran trainer has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad you came today to support me,
Tamtam.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Ya don't gotta pat my head every
time ya see me!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But anyway, 'course I'd come. We trained
together this whole time, so
ya better
show me some results!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You got it!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
How are you feeling, Trainer? Feeling
nervous?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You know best, but I can't help worrying
about you a little.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I feel great though, because I know you're
behind me all the way.

text_block_list.name: First-rate Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Rookie and Super Creek. It
looks like you've done
your training
accordingly.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Good morning. I look forward to today's
race.

text_block_list.name: First-rate Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You're taking this quite casually.
I suppose
this means you're fully
ready to join my
team.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my, when did you become so bold? ♪

text_block_list.name: First-rate Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I-I can see that you two are close,
but that
relationship ends today. I
already have
Super Creek's new training plan ready.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With unwavering confidence, the veteran
trainer walks away.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've finished saying hello, why
don't we go ahead and get
ready
ourselves?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Even though today's race isn't official,
I'll
be sure to grab our first win.
Think of it as
a little present from me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yup! I'm gonna give it all I have! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the race between Super Creek and
the veteran trainer's racer
begins.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... As I expected, she's pretty fast.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But I won't let my trainer and Tamtam's
efforts go to waste!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek accelerates to a breakneck
pace despite it only being
the first half of
the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is just like at the tryouts, but
somehow she's running even faster.

text_block_list.name: First-rate Trainer
text_block_list.text:
She's not even at the halfway mark, but
she's already breaking into a
sprint?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Nah, ya just don't get it. That's not a
sprint—it's her runnin' style. She
always
had the skills to make her debut whenever
she wanted.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The whole reason she hasn't debuted yet is
'cause her trainer was
lookin' out for her.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Bein' as she's not in great shape right
now.

text_block_list.name: First-rate Trainer
text_block_list.text: You're saying this isn't her peak condition?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Da heck, ya didn't know?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
She wasn't doin' well for a few days since
you became her trainer... Well, I s'pose
you wouldn't know, since she's not the
type to tell anyone. She doesn't like
worryin' people.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This whole time, I thought it was my
inability as a rookie to create a suitable
training plan.
Little did I know that she's
been struggling...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...But ya did switch up her trainin',
yeah? It
made her real happy. Kept
tellin' me how
you were growin' day by day.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
In the end, any mistakes you made with
your plan don't matter. What's
most
important is that you care 'bout her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I still can't escape the nagging
feeling
that she's been caring for
me far more than
I've been able to care for her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gathering all of my feelings,
I shout across
the field with all my might
at Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna win so I can keep giving you all
the attention you need!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
True to her word, Super Creek finishes far
ahead of her opponent and
grabs the win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A little while later...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I'm actually kind of nervous now that
my debut race is
approaching.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, we can't have that now.
Everything is going to be just fine,
Trainer.
You're doing such a great job.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Once I debut, I'm going to bring home all
the trophies for us. I'll show
everyone what
a wonderful trainer you are.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I promise I'll take good care of you,
okay? ♪
